versions.subject: Windows Service stop rule (T1489)
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'sc.exe'
selection2:
    CommandLine:
        - 'stop'
selection3:
    CommandLine:
        -'taskkill.exe'
condition: selection1 and selection2 or selection3
versions.spl: (CommandLine IN ("net.exe", "sc.exe") CommandLine="stop") OR CommandLine="-'taskkill.exe'"

versions.subject: Update win_service_stop.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
  - Image|endswith: '\taskkill.exe'
  - Image|endswith:
        - '\sc.exe'
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'stop'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\taskkill.exe" OR (Image IN ("*\\sc.exe", "*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*stop*")

versions.subject: Fix FP Kaspersky Security Center Web Console
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\sc.exe'
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'stop'
filter:
    CommandLine: 'sc  stop KSCWebConsoleMessageQueue' # kaspersky Security Center Web Console double space between sc and stop
    User|startswith: 
        - 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
        - 'AUTORITE NT\Sys' # French language settings
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\sc.exe", "*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*stop*" NOT (CommandLine="sc stop KSCWebConsoleMessageQueue" User IN ("NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM*", "AUTORITE NT\\Sys*"))
